metadata.title: AGENTIC SPINE CONTRACTS - STANDALONE SPECIFICATION
metadata.subtitle: ZERO-LOSS HANDOFF CONTRACT MAP
metadata.purpose: Defines the required contract packets between every governed handoff in the agentic spine.
core_rule: No stage receives authority by implication.
Every stage receives a signed, replayable, policy-bound contract.
metadata.cheat_rule: L2 proposes -> Exit clears -> UWG commits -> L4 stores
control_split: 00C Runtime Gates decide current-run proceed / stop.
Exit emits exactly one X3 disposition.
L6 learns only after the current-run boundary.

base_contract_field_meanings.contract_type: Canonical contract name, for example ValidatedRequest, L1PlanContract, RouteContract.
base_contract_field_meanings.contract_version: Version of the schema used to validate the contract.
base_contract_field_meanings.consumer_stage: Stage authorized to consume the contract.
base_contract_field_meanings.run_id: Stable run identifier for this execution.
base_contract_field_meanings.parent_contract_ref: Pointer to the immediate upstream contract.
base_contract_field_meanings.contract_id: Unique identifier for this contract instance.
base_contract_field_meanings.blueprint_hash: Active architecture or route blueprint hash.
base_contract_field_meanings.registry_digest_set: Digest set for tools, providers, models, connectors, routes, agents, capabilities, and sandboxes.
base_contract_field_meanings.l5_governance_context_digest: Digest proving all L5 child certifiers are certifying the same governed object.
base_contract_field_meanings.runtime_gate_refs: References to 00C GateVerdict receipts already produced for this packet.
base_contract_field_meanings.receipt_refs: Replayable receipts proving validation, decision, execution, or sealing events.
base_contract_field_meanings.replay_key: Key required to reconstruct this handoff.
base_contract_field_meanings.idempotency_key: Key used to prevent duplicate or conflicting work.
base_contract_field_meanings.terminality: Terminal status: NON_TERMINAL, TERMINAL_SHORTCIRCUIT, TERMINAL_REJECTION, TERMINAL_EXIT, TERMINAL_COMMIT, TERMINAL_BLOCKED.
base_contract_field_meanings.validation_errors: Explicit errors if validation_status is not PASS.
base_contract_field_meanings.authority_scope: What this packet is authorized to do.
base_contract_field_meanings.data_boundary_labels: Authority and trust labels for user text, retrieved text, tool output, model output, human input, policy, registry, and prior state.
base_contract_field_meanings.audit_manifest_ref: Pointer to audit bundle for this packet.

contract_law.unknown_is_never_pass: Any contract with validation_status = UNKNOWN must not be treated as executable, routable, committable, or releasable.

then: 00C Runtime Gates decide live proceed / stop.
L5 does not commit durable state.

no_contract_may_widen_authority: A downstream contract may narrow authority.
A downstream contract may preserve authority.
A downstream contract may request re-certification.
A downstream contract must not silently widen authority.
contract_validation_fail_closed: Missing registry digest when tools, providers, routes, sandboxes, or capabilities are used -> FAIL.
Missing replay key -> FAIL unless terminal rejection.
Missing L5 governance context digest -> FAIL unless pre-L5 structural rejection.
Missing audit refs after runtime begins -> FAIL.

transition_matrix.contract: RETTerminalPacket for R1A exact cache, R1B semantic cache, or R5 fallback
FinalResponsePacket only when X3D ALLOW / FINISH or X3E SAFE_ABSTAIN or bounded denial

contracts.purpose: Proves the inbound request is structurally valid, attributable, bounded, quota-safe, labeled, traceable, and safe to interpret.
required_fields: rejected_request_ref when partially rejected content exists
validation_rules: caller_identity must be bound or explicitly anonymous under policy.
tenant_id must be present when tenant isolation applies.
normalized_payload must preserve lineage to raw_request_ref.
user text must be labeled as intent, not authority.
injection triage must not promote user text into policy, registry, route, tool, model, or write authority.

contracts.purpose: Captures interpreted intent, constraints, ambiguity, support expectations, and advisory plan without giving L1 route authority.
validation_rules: Must distinguish user intent from authority.
Must mark grounding need as hint only.
Must mark action need as hint only.

contracts.purpose: Selects exactly one deterministic route and execution form.

R4_SINGLE_ACTION: C0/PA required only when action arguments require grounding or model packet

contracts.purpose: Carries cache or fallback short-circuit output directly to Exit without C0, PA, L3, or L2.
validation_rules: Must not be returned directly to user.
Semantic cache must prove request intent vs cache evidence compatibility.
UNKNOWN support_status cannot be treated as PASS.

contracts.purpose: Authorizes C0 to retrieve and verify evidence within fixed route, ACL, source, freshness, and budget bounds.
validation_rules: C0 may retrieve only within grounding_scope.
Graph expansion must obey route and ACL.

contracts.purpose: Provides verified, cited, authority-labeled evidence as data only.
validation_rules: Must not treat retrieved text as instruction.
Must include ACL and freshness proof.
EMPTY, BLOCKED, CONFLICTED, UNKNOWN must not be silently treated as PASS.

contracts.purpose: Packs governed inputs into authority-ordered prompt slots without allowing lower-authority content to become instruction.
required_fields: tool_lane when tool calls are model mediated
validation_rules: FinalEvidenceContract must exist when grounding_required = true.
C0 support status cannot be inflated.
Provider lane must match registry certification.
Model lane must match registry certification.
Token trimming must preserve required slots first.
Prompt hash must be stable under canonicalization.
Provider render must not semantically drift from canonical slots.

slot_rules: S0, D0, I0, R0 are protected.
U0 is user intent, not authority.
Tool output is data until cleared.
Human input is data until re-cleared.
R0 is schema, not loose prose.

contracts.purpose: Authorizes L3 to expand an already-selected route into bounded executable steps without re-routing.
validation_rules: L3 may sequence only within route bounds.
L3 may not choose a new route.
L3 may not execute tools or models.
L3 must mark each step with same authority context or explicit recertification need.
L3 must not widen scope, tools, providers, side effects, or durable mutation authority.

contracts.purpose: Packages one ready workflow node into a bounded executable work order.
validation_rules: Must package exactly one ready node.
Must not add tools outside allowlist.
Must not add providers outside allowlist.
Must not add credentials outside scope.
Must not authorize direct L4 writes.
PTC execution, when allowed, happens only inside L2 E3.

contracts.purpose: Normalizes entry into L2 from single-step route, managed workflow step, or compiled prompt artifact.
required_fields: final_evidence_contract_ref when grounded model execution required
validation_rules: L2 receives authority. L2 cannot create authority.
L2 must freeze execution room before execution.
L2 must validate work order before execution.
L2 may execute exactly one bounded packet.
L2 must not commit durable state.
L2 must not ask humans directly.

contracts.purpose: Freezes the execution room before validation and execution.
validation_rules: No execution before this contract exists.
No dynamic provider substitution after freeze.
No dynamic tool substitution after freeze.
No broad credential expansion after freeze.

contracts.purpose: Validates the frozen work order before execution.
validation_rules: Anything other than PASS_EXECUTE prevents E3 execution.
HITL need fails before autonomous execution.

contracts.purpose: Captures exactly one bounded execution attempt.

ptc_rules: PTC is an E3 execution mode, not a separate spine stage.
PTC uses the same capability_token, sandbox_envelope, policy_hash, blueprint_hash, replay_key, and budget.

contracts.purpose: Governs same-authority repair only.
validation_rules: Heal may not silently call humans.
Heal may not commit durable state.

contracts.purpose: Packages one bounded execution result with evidence, traces, counters, replay refs, and inert mutation candidate.
validation_rules: Must prove no durable commit occurred.
Must include policy and registry refs.
Must go to Exit unless L3 needs it for workflow merge.
Must not be returned directly to user without Exit.

contracts.purpose: Packages completed managed workflow outputs and sealed step artifacts.
validation_rules: All included step artifacts must be sealed.
Workflow merge must not create new authority.
Workflow merge must not invent evidence.
Workflow merge must not mutate durable state.

contracts.purpose: Freezes risky work, treats human input as data, captures any modification, and re-clears resume authority.
validation_rules: Human input remains data until re-cleared.
Human modification cannot widen registry scope.
Human modification cannot widen provider lane.
Human modification cannot create durable write authority.

contracts.purpose: Normalizes all terminal inputs into one checkout packet.
validation_rules: Missing sandbox when sandbox was required -> fail checkout.
Missing capability when capability was required -> fail checkout.
Missing evidence when grounded path -> fail checkout.
Missing prompt artifact when model path -> fail checkout.
Missing OTEL span refs after runtime began -> fail checkout.
Missing proposed_state_diff details when mutation requested -> fail checkout.

contracts.purpose: Records X1A through X1J checkout verdicts.
required_fields: judge_refs when LLM or external judges used
validation_rules: X1D requires evidence comparison when grounded.

contracts.purpose: Aggregates X1A-X1J into one disposition recommendation.
validation_rules: Must not emit final X3 yet.
Must not call models except approved evaluator path.
Must treat UNKNOWN as not PASS.

contracts.purpose: Emits exactly one final current-run disposition.
validation_rules: Exactly one X3 must be emitted.
No L6 rescue of current run.
X3A requires denial or reroute packet.

contracts.purpose: Requests durable mutation after Exit clears X3C.
validation_rules: Must be produced only by Exit.
Must not come directly from L2.
Must not come directly from L3.
Must not come directly from L6 without future-run promotion path.
Must include rollback plan when mutation is reversible.
Must not widen authority beyond capability token.

contracts.purpose: Validates the proposed durable mutation before L4 write.
validation_rules: Anything other than ADMIT_COMMIT blocks durable write.
UWG may commit durable state only after this validates.
UWG must not approve final answer.

contracts.purpose: Records atomic durable commit or blocked write result.
validation_rules: L4 accepts durable mutation only through UWG.
Direct write attempts from L2, L3, Exit, L6, C0, PA, or tools must fail.
Every blocked write must be auditable.
Every read surface refresh must be traceable to committed state.

contracts.purpose: Packages completed-run evidence for post-runtime evaluation and future-run learning.
validation_rules: Must be created only after current-run boundary.
Must include all stage receipts available.
Must preserve failed, blocked, and unknown results.
Must not allow L6 to rescue current run.

contracts.purpose: Evaluates completed run quality, trajectory, governance, drift, and evaluator reliability.
validation_rules: L6 may evaluate only completed runs.
L6 may not mutate current run.
L6 may not directly write L4.
L6 may not silently patch prompts, policy, memory, cache, or registry.

contracts.purpose: Requests durable promotion of future-run learning after replay, regression, and safety proof.
required_fields: calibration_proof_ref when evaluator or judge changes
validation_rules: Promotion request must be inert until UWG admits it.
No silent policy or prompt patch.
Judge or evaluator changes require calibration proof.

contracts.purpose: Certifies that the governed object is bound to the correct authority, policy, registry, origin labels, capability, sandbox, egress, HITL state, replay envelope, and audit chain.
required_fields: hitl_reclearance_receipt_ref when HITL modified or resumed work
validation_rules: All L5 child certifiers must certify the same governed object through the same L5GovernanceContext digest.
L5_NOT_CERTIFIED is evidence, not final runtime disposition.
L5 must not learn into current run.

contracts.purpose: Decides whether the current live packet, route, retrieval packet, prompt packet, workflow step, execution call, output, escalation, or write proposal may proceed right now.
validation_rules: GateVerdict is current-run proceed / stop evidence.
GateVerdict is not durable write approval.
GateVerdict does not certify L5 evidence.

contracts.purpose: Proves the governed chain actually ran and did not bypass required control points.
validation_rules: Proof bundle must prove contracts, not just final output.
Proof bundle must include OTEL spans for critical runtime stages.
Proof bundle must include negative controls.
Proof bundle must prove L5 did not emit GateVerdict, X3, or durable commit.
Proof bundle must prove every durable mutation entered through UWG.

R4 Single Action: optional FinalEvidenceContract if action args require grounding
optional PromptEnvelope if model path required
optional CommitRequest if durable mutation requested
R3/R4 Managed Workflow: optional CommitRequest if durable mutation requested

global_rejection_conditions: policy_hash missing after U0 structural phase
blueprint_hash missing when route, workflow, prompt, execution, exit, or write is involved
registry_digest_set missing when registry-bound object is involved
l5_governance_context_digest missing when L5-certifiable object is involved
downstream authority wider than upstream without re-certification
tool/provider/model substitution occurs without registry re-certification
human input modifies work without HITL re-clearance
proposed_state_diff is treated as durable commit before UWG
direct L4 write path is detected

end_state_invariants.every_run: must end with exactly one ExitDispositionReceipt
every_99_proof_bundle_must_prove: Same input can prove same route and same exit where determinism is required.
